hero_lede: Bookings, consultations, partnerships, anything else — drop a line and a real person on our team usually gets back to you within 24 hours on working days. No bots, no ticket queue.
response_body: Usually within 24 hours on working days
emergency_body: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, call your local emergency services (112 in the EU) — do not use this form.
reviews_body: Independent, verified reviews collected by Doctify from patients treated by our clinicians across Europe.
form_success_body: Thank you for reaching out. Our team will get back to you within 24 hours.
form_generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form_network_error: Could not reach the server. Please try again.

country.noWalkIn: Registered office only — not a walk-in clinic. Consultations take place by video call.
country.onlineOnlyBody: We serve {country} as an online clinic. Our registered office is in Ireland.
country.emergencyNote: Global Health is not an emergency service. If your symptoms are urgent, contact your local emergency number.
country.descriptionTemplate: Contact Global Health {country}: {phone}, {email}. Online video consultations with doctors registered with {regulator}.
country.introOffice: Global Health is an online clinic. Consultations take place by secure video with doctors registered with {regulator}, and our registered office is in {city}.
country.introOnline: Global Health serves {country} as an online-only clinic: consultations take place by secure video with doctors registered with {regulator}. We hold no premises in {country}.
country.reachBodyTemplate: Booking a consultation is the fastest route to a doctor. The phone line covers bookings, billing and account questions rather than clinical advice, and is answered in {languages}. For emergencies call {emergency}.
country.regulatoryBodyTemplate: Doctors consulting through Global Health {country} are registered with {regulator}. A {certificate} is issued by the doctor who assessed you. Entitlement to sick-leave benefit is decided separately by {benefitBody} under its own rules.
country.faq1AOffice: Our {city} address is a registered office, not a walk-in clinic. Every consultation happens by secure video call.
country.faq1AOnline: We operate in {country} as an online-only clinic, so there is no address to visit. Our registered office is in Ireland and consultations happen by video call.
country.faq2A: Yes. Doctors seeing patients in {country} hold registration with {regulator}, and each doctor's profile states their registration.
country.faq3A: It is issued by a registered doctor after assessing you and carries the same standing as one issued in person. Employers set their own policies, and benefit entitlement is decided by {benefitBody} against its own criteria.
country.faq4Q: Which languages can I be seen in?
country.faq4A: The phone line is answered in {languages}, and each doctor's profile lists the languages they consult in.
country.faq5Q: What if I need urgent care?
country.faq5A: Global Health is not an emergency service and the phone line is not monitored for emergencies. Call {emergency} or attend your nearest emergency department.
